falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically featured shallow drawdowns with 4,800 as structural support; a breach invalidates the analog and suggests a deeper correction than the pattern allows

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern was characterized by volatility compression and VIX peaking near 28; sustained elevated fear breaks the pattern's behavioral signature

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 is simultaneously down more than 2% week-over-week
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety/growth-scare dynamic inconsistent with the bottom_2024_aug regime, which saw yields and equities stabilize together in a soft-landing pricing

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
